subject.title: Plugin `message_sending` hooks silently bypassed on channel agent-reply delivery paths (2026.5.26, still present in 2026.6.1)

question: Which open fix branch should become the canonical repair for this safety-hook bypass: the broader exactly-once Telegram branch, a narrower dispatcher-only branch, or a new maintainer-owned replacement?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but there are several overlapping open PRs with different hook ownership choices and proof states; automation should not create another fix or pick the permanent safety-boundary model without maintainer intent.

options.title: Repair and select the broader branch
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93216 as the canonical path after rebase, draft exit, and correction of the known exactly-once review blocker.

options.title: Land a narrow dispatcher fix first
options.body: Choose a smaller branch such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92976 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90371, while explicitly leaving streamed-final Telegram coverage tracked here.

options.title: Replace with a maintainer-owned branch
options.body: Close or pause the overlapping contributor branches and implement the shared dispatcher plus Telegram streaming boundary in one fresh maintainer-owned PR.

recommendation.title: Repair and select the broader branch
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93216 as the canonical path after rebase, draft exit, and correction of the known exactly-once review blocker.

likelyOwner.reason: amknight owns the broadest current candidate branch and is tied to the active maintainer-labeled fix path for this issue.
